objective: Produce at least one independently auditable, crisis-robust, non-starved, after-cost BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT Spot strategy architecture that survives a fresh OOS evaluation; otherwise close Generation 2 with GEN2_NO_ROBUST_EDGE_FOUND.

known_development.note: Contains previously observed Generation-1 development/blind/crisis material and can never again be called fresh OOS.

stop_rules: A failed candidate is retained and cannot be rescued by post-outcome parameter changes on the same evidence.
If no preregistered hypothesis survives its required gates, Generation 2 terminates with GEN2_NO_ROBUST_EDGE_FOUND.
Fresh OOS failure cannot be retuned against the same OOS.
No Forward promotion occurs automatically from historical results.
